decks.notes: This Legacy 1 vs 1 deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into play by utilizing various reanimation spells like Reanimate, Exhume, and Animate Dead alongside efficient discard spells such as Thoughtseize and Unmask. The goal is to fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning play. The deck also includes cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to accelerate the reanimation process and Faithless Looting for card selection. The strategy revolves around cheating big creatures into play ahead of schedule to overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play Death's Shadow and utilize cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Reanimate and Murktide Regent to bring back key threats or generate card advantage. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure smooth mana development. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control of the game through disruption and powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire deck in one turn. The deck includes various cards that support this combo, such as Goblin Engineer to tutor for pieces, and Red Elemental Blast/Pyroblast to protect the combo from counterspells. Additionally, cards like Goblin Welder and Breya's Apprentice provide additional utility and synergy with the artifacts in the deck. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently deploy artifacts while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Bauble provide card advantage and enable powerful synergies with artifacts. The deck aims to generate mana with cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal to power out threats like Thought Monitor and Otawara, Soaring City. By combining aggro strategies with artifact synergies, this deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and control the battlefield.

The deck focuses on casting cheap creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent while utilizing the cascade mechanic to generate additional value and card advantage. Key cards include Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its game plan. The goal is to assemble a board presence quickly and maintain pressure on the opponent, using efficient spells and creatures to control the game and secure victory.

The deck focuses on casting low-cost spells that can cascade into powerful threats, aiming to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive plays. Utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into high-impact creatures like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls, the deck looks to pressure the opponent early and maintain control with counterspells like Mystical Dispute and Force of Will. The deck's mana base is designed to support its aggressive strategy, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of its spells.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies with counterspells and removal spells while generating card advantage and controlling the board with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils. The inclusion of cards like Dress Down and The Wandering Emperor allows for flexibility in dealing with various threats, while Shark Typhoon provides an alternate win condition. The deck aims to control the game by answering threats efficiently and out-valuing the opponent through card advantage and powerful spells.

The deck focuses on using cards like Show and Tell, Omniscience, and Sneak Attack to quickly drop powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield. It also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces from disruption. The mana base is built around efficiently generating the necessary colors of mana to cast the big creatures and spells, with the potential for explosive plays thanks to cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats before they can react effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly ramp up mana and cast powerful threats such as Primeval Titan and Eldrazi creatures. It also includes tools like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map to search for key lands and Pithing Needle to disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck aims to control the game by generating massive amounts of mana and playing high-impact threats that can quickly take over the game. It also includes utility lands like Glacial Chasm and Karakas to protect itself and disrupt opponent's strategies.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing Death's Shadow, a creature that gets stronger the lower the player's life total is. It includes cards that allow the player to control the opponent's hand and disrupt their strategy while also providing protection through counterspells. The deck also includes efficient card draw and removal spells to keep the pressure on the opponent. The goal is to quickly reduce the player's own life total to empower Death's Shadow and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. The deck utilizes protection spells like Force of Will and Orim's Chant to ensure the combo goes off successfully. Aether Vial and Urza's Saga provide additional utility and consistency in setting up the combo. Baleful Strix and Teferi, Time Raveler offer disruption and card advantage, while Ponder and Brainstorm help dig for combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through its powerful combo synergy.

This deck focuses on playing powerful aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss to apply early pressure on the opponent. By using cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, it disrupts the opponent's mana base, limiting their ability to cast spells effectively. Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void further restrict the opponent's resources, making it difficult for them to respond to the deck's threats. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, leveraging the deck's disruptive elements to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain control and disruption over the opponent's plays while utilizing Stoneforge Mystic to search for and equip powerful artifacts like Umezawa's Jitte and Batterskull. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and value through the use of Yorion, Sky Nomad and blink effects like Venser, Shaper Savant and Soulherder. It includes a variety of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Plague Engineer, as well as counter spells such as Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its game plan. Overall, it focuses on outlasting and outmaneuvering the opponent through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into play from the graveyard, utilizing cards like Exhume, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to cheat creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Unmask and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up powerful plays. Additionally, the deck includes ways to ramp mana quickly with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, allowing for explosive turns that can overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on using various spells and card manipulation to assemble the necessary pieces for the combo finish with Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate mana quickly, while cards like Ponder and Brainstorm help to dig for key combo pieces. Force of Will and Daze provide protection while Personal Tutor and Cabal Ritual help set up the combo. The goal is to efficiently and effectively set up the Doomsday combo and win the game in a single turn.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the game by playing disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex while also utilizing powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also aims to generate advantage with cards like Retrofitter Foundry and Esper Sentinel. It ensures consistency and resilience with cards like Karakas and Wasteland, while also providing strong finishers with cards like Solitude and Emeria's Call. The deck aims to dominate the early game and maintain control throughout to secure the win.
